scope: Native deployed bootstrap orchestration and system packages; separate from SDK inventory
verified_contracts: Task identity before artifact location; task manifest selection before system installation
First matching resource selects system packages; update precedes install; literal argv and noninteractive environment
System-phase failures retain 2000-character stderr tails and prevent application loading
Prebuilt/extracted app directory reaches the native loader, bundled assets and mount bindings without environment mutation
Real queue/API/task startup, initialization, execution and task deadline deletion
Preparation failures enter queue/API/task error responders without invoking user registration
Cancelling installation kills the direct package-manager process
native_adaptations: Compiled Rust dependencies replace Python import probes, sys.path attachment and pip repair; excludedPackages has no native import meaning
start_deployed requires a named deployed resource; live-source startup remains separate and pending
Owned context carries resolved paths; no execve, process-global path or environment mutation
System declarations require string arrays; malformed untyped declarations receive typed system-phase diagnostics
Native diagnostic quoting, UTF-8 loss handling, missing-command causes and entry-time configuration validation
Extraction runs on the blocking pool and cannot be interrupted once running; package-manager descendants follow their own lifecycle
pending_contracts: Native deployment payloads and automatic platform launch (compiled-worker packaging is tracked in native-artifact.json)
Python-compatible runtime installation and excluded-package repair
